rationale: Independently reasoned from the normative contract only; no candidate code read and no measurements taken. The bundle schema requires claim.total to be a nonnegative exact int, and the rules declare booleans-as-counts invalid. Here claim.total is the JSON literal true, so the claim is malformed regardless of every other field. To isolate exactly that defect, the rest of the fixture is made fully consistent: two findings rows (one evidence:observed, one evidence:lead) justify observed=1 and lead=1; two nonempty files rows carry eval_unparsed=0 and unparsed_spawns=0 throughout, so the error sum is 0 and errors=0 is correct; findings are nonempty so clean=false is correct; and had total been an integer its correct value would be 2. Because the verdict cannot reach count comparison on malformed input, the expected code is 2 (could-not-evaluate) with the single stable id evidence_audit_input_invalid; no count-mismatch or clean-claim ids should appear since input validation precedes verdict arithmetic and the snapshot digest check is against snapshot bytes, not the claim.
